description: This PHP class, DataGroupHelper, handles database interactions related to permissions data in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to read YAML configurations for APIs, data groups, and screens, and methods to insert permissions data into the database, while managing entity identifiers.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing permissions data, including reading YAML configs and inserting permission records into the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permission definitions from a YAML file and converts them into Api objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads data group permission definitions from a YAML file into DataGroup objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads screen permission definitions from YAML into Screen objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permission entries into the database based on YAML configurations.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts data group permission entries into the database from YAML.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts screen permission entries into the database, including associated role permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the database ID for a given data group by name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Retrieves screen ID based on module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Gets module ID from name, with caching.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Gets user role ID from name, with caching.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a data group and user role into the database.
